meta.title: Edit Evaluation Time: Edit Evaluation Time with future date far beyond allowed range

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ as the buyer; this is the required starting state.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and select Edit Evaluation Time.
Verify that the Edit Evaluation Time window opened.

args.goal: in the Edit Evaluation Time window, enter a custom end date of 31 December 2100 at 12:00 PM, click Ok, and leave the resulting saved or refused response visible so what happens is recorded

steps.note: Perform the absolute far-future date entry and submit it, which cannot be parameterized by the domain timing step.
Verify the resulting screen has no crash, server error, raw values, or rendering failure.
